# Version 4.158.0 (Unreleased)
> **Engine fixes and hash initialization**

## Highlights

The upcoming 4.158.0 release incorporates upstream Skia m158 bug fixes. The shared hash-code polyfill also switches to OS-backed randomness while preserving stable hash codes within each process.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Upstream m158 fixes** — Updates the bundled native engine with upstream chrome/m158 bug fixes. ([#5702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5702))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Hash-code seed uses OS randomness** — The shared HashCode polyfill in SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now seeds from RandomNumberGenerator rather than System.Random. Hash codes remain stable within a process and randomized between processes; first use now loads the cryptography library. — ❤️ [@rolfbjarne](https://github.com/rolfbjarne) ([#5408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5408))
